messages:
oncall-alyssa: Pager: multiple generation requests in eu-central seeing 5-10x latency starting ~10:42 UTC. Alerts from gen-queue; error rate still low. Raising incident.
inc-bot: [ALERT] Incident created: INC-2026-045 - eu-central generation latency spike. Pager routed to oncall-alyssa. Runbook: /runbooks/gen-latency
ops-jordan: I'm on it. Can someone draft an initial status page blurb? Need customer-facing impact ASAP.
eng-lead-raj: looking at traces. KV cache miss rate spiked; a few hosts show GC and driver-level errors on m4dedicated-2. Rolling a lightweight routing change to divert traffic to eu-west. ETA ~10 minutes.
product-kevin: For status page: say affected surface = hosted generation API in eu-central, degraded generation latency for longer completions. Embeddings unaffected. Keep it concise.
customer-success-lina: Suggest wording: "some customers may experience slower responses for longer completions" — teams will ask about streaming interruptions.
legal-maya: Please avoid the word "outage" unless confirmed widespread failure. Use "degraded performance".
ops-jordan: Draft v1 below — please edit inline:
```
We are investigating elevated generation latency impacting the eu-central region. Some requests may experience slower response times; embeddings and most other services appear unaffected. Engineers are deploying a temporary routing change to reduce load. Estimated mitigation timeframe: ~30 minutes. We will provide updates every 20 minutes.
```
product-kevin: change "Estimated mitigation timeframe" -> "Estimated mitigation timeframe" (ok) and add a short line about how to contact support if impacted.
eng-lead-raj: add "No data exposure has been detected." after the mitigation timeframe.
ops-jordan: Updated draft v2:
```
We are actively investigating elevated generation latency in the eu-central region. Some customers may experience slower responses for longer completions. Embeddings and other API surfaces are not impacted. Engineers have deployed a temporary routing change to shift traffic to eu-west while we stabilize affected hosts. Estimated mitigation timeframe: ~30 minutes. No data exposure has been detected. We will post updates approximately every 20 minutes.
```
product-kevin: LGTM.
customer-success-lina: Add contact line: "If you rely on low tail-latency SLAs, please contact support@redwood.ai."
legal-maya: Approved wording.
inc-bot: [PUB REQUEST] Status page draft ready for publish. Approvals: product-kevin, legal-maya. ops-jordan requested publish.
ops-jordan: publishing now to status.redwood.ai -> published.
eng-lead-raj: routing change shows CPU pressure easing on most hosts; 3/12 hosts still under investigation, continuing stabilization and host restarts.
oncall-alyssa: Note for next update: metrics show ~60% reduction in tail latency after reroute; still elevated vs baseline.
ops-jordan: Next update draft (10:55 UTC):
```
Update (10:55 UTC): Traffic has been rerouted to eu-west and we observe a ~60% reduction in tail latency for affected requests. We continue to see elevated latencies relative to baseline while engineers remediate underlying host issues. No user data impact has been detected. We will continue monitoring and will update again in ~20 minutes.
```
product-kevin: publish this with timestamp.
ops-jordan: published.
eng-lead-raj: root cause hypothesis: kernel/driver regression on a recent maint image caused cascading GC/panic behavior on a host pool. Remediation plan: rolling restarts and pin to previous driver. Estimated full recovery: 45-60 minutes.
customer-success-lina: Add note for Dedicated customers that they may see minor routing delays; ops-jordan please add.
ops-jordan: Added note to dedicated customers section.
inc-bot: [RESOLVE PREP] Incident will be marked resolved after tail-latency is within baseline for 30 minutes. oncall-alyssa to confirm.
oncall-alyssa: Monitoring shows baseline restored at 11:28 UTC, sustained for 35 minutes. Marking resolved.
ops-jordan: Final status page resolve draft:
```
Resolved (11:31 UTC): The elevated generation latency in eu-central has been resolved. Engineers mitigated a host-level issue by rolling restarts and reverting a recent driver update. Traffic has been normalized and tail latencies are within expected baselines. No customer data was exposed. If you continue to see issues, please contact support@redwood.ai.
```
product-kevin: publishing resolve now.
inc-bot: [PUBLISHED] Incident INC-2026-045 resolved notice published.
customer-success-lina: I'll notify impacted customers with the post-incident summary template and attach relevant traces.
legal-maya: tagging for post-incident review and compliance notes.
eng-lead-raj: opening RFC/root-cause ticket and scheduling postmortem.
ops-jordan: thanks team. Closing thread."
